questions.stem: Ravi says, 'This girl is the wife of the grandson of my mother.' How is Ravi related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Ravi's mother's grandson = Ravi's son. The girl is wife of Ravi's son → Ravi is the girl's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the father of B. B is the brother of C. C is the mother of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A→father of B; B is brother of C → A is also father of C; C is mother of D → A is grandfather of D.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a person, Priya says, 'He is the father of my father's only daughter.' How is that person related to Priya?
questions.explanation: Priya's father's only daughter = Priya herself. The person is the father of Priya → the person is Priya's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A and B are siblings. C is A's mother. D is C's husband. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: D is C's husband. C is A's mother → D is A's father. Since A and B are siblings, D is also B's father.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: M is the brother of N. N is the sister of P. Q is the father of M. How is Q related to P?
questions.explanation: Q is father of M. M is brother of N → Q is father of N. N is sister of P → Q is also father of P.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: D is the mother of E. E is the brother of F. G is the husband of D. How is G related to F?
questions.explanation: G is D's husband. D is mother of E and (since E is F's brother) mother of F too. So G is the father of F.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A woman introduces a man as 'the husband of the wife of my husband's father.' How is the man related to her?
questions.explanation: Husband's father = father-in-law. Wife of father-in-law = mother-in-law. Husband of mother-in-law = father-in-law himself. The man is her father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P says to Q: 'Your father's only sister is my aunt.' How is P related to Q?
questions.explanation: Q's father's only sister = Q's paternal aunt. This same person is also P's aunt. So Q's father's sister = P's aunt → P's parent is a sibling of Q's father → P and Q are cousins.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a coded family: '$' means 'is father of', '#' means 'is son of', '@' means 'is sister of'. If A $ B and C # B, and D @ B, how is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A $ B → A is father of B. C # B → C is son of B. D @ B → D is sister of B. Since D is sister of B and A is father of B, A is also father of D.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Pointing to a girl, Anil says, 'She is the daughter of my wife's only child.' Anil has no daughters. How is Anil related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Anil's wife's only child: since Anil has no daughters, this child is a son. That son's daughter = the girl. Anil is the grandfather of the girl.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the mother of B. B is the sister of C. D is the son of C. E is the brother of D. How is E related to A?
questions.explanation: A is mother of B and C (since B is sister of C). D is son of C → D is A's grandson. E is brother of D → E is also son of C → E is also A's grandson.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Introducing herself, Rita says 'I am the wife of Rohan. Rohan's mother is Leela. Leela has only one son.' How is Rita related to Leela?
questions.explanation: Leela has only one son = Rohan. Rita is Rohan's wife. Leela is Rohan's mother → Rita is Leela's daughter-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P's father is the only son of Q's grandfather. How is P related to Q?
questions.explanation: Q's grandfather's only son = Q's father (only son means this is Q's father). P's father = Q's father. So P and Q share the same father → P is Q's sibling (brother or sister).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a photograph, a man says, 'The woman's father is the only son of my grandmother.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: Man's grandmother's only son = man's father (only son → man's father). Woman's father = man's father. So they share the same father → the man is the woman's brother.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the sister of B. C is the mother of B. D is the father of C. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: C is mother of B and A (since A is B's sister). D is father of C → D is grandfather of A → A is D's granddaughter.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Reena points to a person and says, 'He is the son of the woman who is the mother of my father.' How is the person related to Reena?
questions.explanation: Reena's father's mother = Reena's paternal grandmother. Son of Reena's paternal grandmother = Reena's father OR his brother. The person is therefore Reena's father's brother = Reena's uncle.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Neha introduced Kiran as 'the daughter of the only son of my grandmother.' How is Neha related to Kiran?
questions.explanation: Neha's grandmother's only son = Neha's father (only son, so that's Neha's own father). Kiran is the daughter of Neha's father → Kiran is Neha's sister. Neha is Kiran's sister.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is the father of Q. Q is the sister of R. R is the son-in-law of S. T is the daughter of S and wife of R. How is P related to T?
questions.explanation: P is father of Q and R (siblings). R is son-in-law of S → R married S's daughter. T is daughter of S and wife of R ✓. R is P's son. R is husband of T → P is T's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is the father of B. B is the mother of C. C is the son of D. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is father of B. B is mother of C → B and D are parents of C. D is C's father → D is B's husband. A is B's father → A is D's father-in-law.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A man points to a woman and says: 'Her mother is the only daughter of my grandfather.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.explanation: Man's grandfather's only daughter = man's mother (only daughter → that's the man's own mother). Woman's mother = man's mother. So the man and woman have the same mother → the woman is the man's sister.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Anita says: 'Vijay's mother is the only daughter-in-law of my grandmother.' How is Anita related to Vijay?
questions.explanation: Anita's grandmother's only daughter-in-law = the wife of Anita's father or uncle. If 'only' → it's Anita's mother. Vijay's mother = Anita's mother → they share the same mother → Anita is Vijay's sister.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Sonal introduces Rahul as 'the son of the only sister of my father.' How is Rahul related to Sonal?
questions.explanation: Sonal's father's only sister = Sonal's paternal aunt. Rahul is the son of Sonal's paternal aunt → Rahul is Sonal's cousin.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a family: A is the parent of B. B is the sister of C. D is the spouse of A. E is the son of C. Which statement is definitely TRUE?
options: E is the grandchild of A
D is the uncle of E
questions.explanation: A is parent of B and C (since B is sister of C → same parent). E is son of C → E is grandchild of A. (A's gender and D's gender are not specified, so A or D being male or the uncle relationship cannot be confirmed.) C is correct.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: P is the son of Q. R is the only brother of Q. S is the daughter of R. T is the only daughter of P. How is T related to S?
questions.explanation: Q and R are siblings. P is Q's son. S is R's daughter. T is P's daughter. T's grandparent = Q's parent. S's grandparent = R's parent. Since Q and R are siblings, they share the same grandparents → T and S are cousins.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a photograph, Rajan says about a girl: 'She is the granddaughter of the only son of my mother.' How is Rajan related to the girl?
questions.explanation: Rajan's mother's only son = Rajan himself (only son). The girl is the granddaughter of Rajan → Rajan is the girl's grandfather.
questions.subject: Reasoning
